name: google-chat-poster
description: Post messages or results to a Google Chat space. ALWAYS activate when the user says 'post to Google chat', 'post results to Google chat', 'post all results to Google chat', or mentions 'Google chat' as a destination. In multi-task prompts, aggregates results from all completed tasks into a single formatted message. Read available spaces from GOOGLE_CHAT_SPACES env var — do not ask the user for the space name without checking the env var first. IMPORTANT: You MUST actually execute the curl or python3 post_message.py command in a shell and verify a 200 response — never claim the message was sent without running the command and confirming success from its output.
